name: Ottar
title: Serjeant of the Hoargate
examine: Twenty-one winters on this wall and he still counts every party through and every party back. The count is written up. The second column is shorter.
lines: Warm yourself. The fire is the Crown's and the Crown is not here to grudge it.
Sign the board on your way through. It saves us guessing later.
North of my wall the road is a rumour with snow on it.
